items.title: Pay dental invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag spätestens 30 Tage nach dem Rechnungsdatum auf das unten angegebene Konto.
items.computation: The invoice is dated Thursday 4 September 2025 (Rechnungsdatum). This is a private company's invoice, so ordinary calendar computation under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB applies (no deemed-delivery rule, since that only applies to authorities). Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event (4 Sep) is not counted; counting starts 5 Sep. 30 days later lands on Saturday 4 October 2025. Under §193 BGB, since the last day is a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 6 October 2025. Allowing roughly one business day for a bank transfer to arrive (§675s BGB), the payment should be sent by about 2 October 2025.
